definitions.granularity: chunk row; doc-level metrics deduplicate doc_id in rank order
definitions.semantic_recall: recall_at_k over human relevant_doc_ids; denominator is the number of distinct gold docs; this is not ANN recall
definitions.sparse_score: English path: ts_rank_cd weighted cover density, higher is better, not a probability and not comparable across queries. CJK path: number of matched query bigrams, also only comparable within a query.
definitions.latency_query_ms: execute + fetch around the retrieval SELECT only
definitions.latency_db_ms: pool borrow + transaction + timeout setup + execute + fetch
